newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly down, short-term rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly down, short-term rates fall.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were largely weaker, with short-term rates falling more than 30 basis points, traders said.
They said appetite for swaps, especially short-term issues, had waned after the quarter-end window-dressing of banks.
PHIBOR are settled the next day.
"The rates are just correcting. There was some demand in recent days as banks tried to beef up their positions for the usual quarter-end window-dressing," one trader said.
PHIBOR are average swap rates of banks in the country.
